records.algorithm_name: 守卫串行链汇合配对与空隙调度

parameters.selection_policy: one fixed direct construction; no online E0 selection; post-hoc development comparison only

batch_preparation.scope: one-off spec, Git source and frozen official hash preflight; before batch budget T0; no graph algorithm/solver/evaluator calls

solver_report.scope: Static communication/compute calendar; no capacity certificate, COPY contention, or optimality claim.

timing.evaluation_precision: time.perf_counter wall seconds; external process lifecycle
timing.utc: UTC from datetime.now(timezone.utc); start and finish recorded at execution

solver.method: 在原始eligible二元依赖与COPY收缩关系相等且无alias的分叉汇合图上，以最大串行链、最长剩余路径、最后父与join至多k平方核配对、持久AVL空闲区间插入直接构造；否则回退容量窗口。明确移植P3 a37eb931方法。无真实COPY竞争/容量仿真、无在线E0或候选搜索。

measurement.solver_scope: External perf_counter: before spawning a fresh Python solver through process exit after graph load, contraction/indexing, direct construction, official structural derivation checks and final two-field plan write; no E0 or online candidate comparison. Parent startup observation and durable dispatch bookkeeping are included. Fresh process; OS filesystem caches are uncontrolled.
measurement.evaluation_scope: Separate fresh unmodified official P2 CLI process after solver exit, including imports, input/plan/config reads, complete evaluation, full result/trace/log writes and process exit. This time is not included in solver wall.

budget.stop_reason: fixed direct construction and one external E0 completed

measurement.offline_costs: 完整tensor_packet公开开发500格已测501solver/500E0（含071记录故障额外1solver，零重复成功E0），另更早R1/R2/R3共28solver/26E0，原件分别保存。现有100图结构扫描/下界分析和P3固定head-tail数据复用见all500与THEORY_REVIEW，不在本批再扫描/评分。容量prototype曾对007/025各进程内构造1次共3.1339894秒，0E0；独立容量13项、gap原7+审查5项、集成33项小图测试通过，最近集成0.106秒，均非当前官方图评分，不作为solver速度。新33个固定开发单元的source/输入/核数事前冻结；只有一个结构构造候选/单元，无case特判、无训练/编译/GPU/云作业/Actions；模型账户费用未测。 Subsequent fixed 33-unit development pilot at data commit 2428372b52a1eeb86dd5fed08ce33346ae79e6fc used 33 additional solver and 33 E0 calls; all successes and ties are retained. No evaluation or graph scan was used to write this 24-unit design; read-only saved-result analysis is separate. These units are mechanism falsification, not a new full500 algorithm report.

missing_reasons.provenance.environment.peak_rss_bytes: Peak RSS not sampled by this runner; CPU/RAM inventory and single worker/thread configuration are recorded.

notes: Fixed finite development comparison, not an online portfolio or a full 100-case/1..5-core algorithm result.
All declared method attempts are retained, including worse results and predeclared unsupported structures; no retry.
Makespan is simulated cycles; solver wall and separate external E0 wall are real seconds. The official 5–10 minute guidance is not a 600-second disqualification rule.
Fresh Python process for each attempt; OS/filesystem caches were not cleared. Threads=1 is the configured solver/BLAS limit, not a hardware inventory or OS-thread measurement.
Result and trace gzip files preserve complete original bytes; raw and compressed hashes are recorded in run.json.
Code/source and artifact checks are not independent scientific validation or final algorithm acceptance.

Frozen-byte/Git preflight is recorded separately as batch_preparation before the batch budget T0; it is not algorithm preprocessing. The batch envelope includes serial receipt/compression work, which is not solver wall.
